name: Device info
desc: Battery, storage, network, time and more.

tools.label: Date and time
tools.hint: Tell the current date and time.

tools.label: Battery
tools.hint: Tell the battery level and charging state.

tools.label: Device info
tools.hint: Tell the phone model, Android version, screen, language and time zone.

tools.label: Storage and memory
tools.hint: Tell free storage and free RAM.

tools.label: Network status
tools.hint: Tell whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is connected.

tools.label: Wi-Fi details
tools.hint: Tell the Wi-Fi network name and signal.

tools.label: Bluetooth status
tools.hint: Tell if Bluetooth is on and which devices are paired.

tools.label: Step counter
tools.hint: Tell the steps counted by the phone.

tools.label: Light sensor
tools.hint: Tell how bright the room is.

about: Tells you the time, battery, storage, network, Bluetooth, steps and light. It only reads.
privacy: Shared only when you ask.

name: Device controls
desc: Flashlight, volume, brightness and phone modes.

tools.label: Flashlight
tools.hint: Turn the flashlight on or off.

tools.label: Set brightness
tools.hint: Make the screen brighter or dimmer.

tools.label: Read brightness
tools.hint: Tell the current screen brightness.

tools.label: Set volume
tools.hint: Raise or lower the assistant or media volume.

tools.label: Read volume
tools.hint: Tell the current volumes (assistant, media, ring, alarm).

tools.label: Read ringer mode
tools.hint: Tell if the phone is on normal, vibrate or silent.

tools.label: Set ringer mode
tools.hint: Switch the phone to normal, vibrate or silent.

tools.label: Vibrate
tools.hint: Make the phone vibrate.

tools.label: Do Not Disturb
tools.hint: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off.

tools.label: Media control
tools.hint: Play, pause, or skip music in other apps.

tools.label: Screen timeout
tools.hint: Change how long the screen stays on.

tools.label: Auto-rotate
tools.hint: Turn screen auto-rotate on or off.

tools.label: Wi-Fi, NFC and volume panels
tools.hint: Show the quick panel for Wi-Fi, mobile data, NFC or volume.

about: Changes simple settings for you: flashlight, brightness, volume, ringer, Do Not Disturb, media keys and auto-rotate.
needs: Android asks the first time for settings and Do Not Disturb.
privacy: Nothing leaves your phone.

name: Alarms & timers
desc: Set alarms and timers.

tools.label: Set alarm
tools.hint: Set an alarm that rings with sound.

tools.label: List alarms
tools.hint: See the alarms that are set.

tools.label: Cancel alarm
tools.hint: Cancel an alarm.

tools.label: Change an alarm
tools.hint: Move an alarm to a new time.

tools.label: Set timer
tools.hint: Start a countdown timer that rings with sound.

tools.label: List timers
tools.hint: See the running timers.

tools.label: Cancel timer
tools.hint: Stop a running timer.

about: Sets alarms and timers in your clock app, and lets you change or cancel alarms.
privacy: Nothing leaves your phone.

name: Reminders
desc: Get reminded at a time, with a sound.

tools.label: Reminder
tools.hint: Remind you at a time or after a while, with a sound.

tools.label: List reminders
tools.hint: See the reminders that are still waiting.

tools.label: Cancel a reminder
tools.hint: Cancel a waiting reminder.

tools.label: Change a reminder
tools.hint: Change the time or text of a waiting reminder.

about: Reminds you at a time or after a while, once or every day or week. It rings and vibrates.
privacy: Nothing leaves your phone.

name: Apps & settings
desc: Open apps and settings, use the clipboard.

tools.label: Open apps
tools.hint: Launch an installed app by name.

tools.label: Open camera
tools.hint: Open the camera for a photo or video.

tools.label: App settings page
tools.hint: Open an app's info page (permissions, storage, uninstall).

tools.label: Open settings
tools.hint: Open a system settings screen.

tools.label: Read clipboard
tools.hint: Read the text the user copied.

tools.label: Write clipboard
tools.hint: Copy text to the clipboard.

tools.label: Show notification
tools.hint: Post a notification on the phone.

tools.label: List installed apps
tools.hint: List the apps that can be opened.

tools.label: Open a web link
tools.hint: Open a web address in the browser.

tools.label: Share text
tools.hint: Open the Android share sheet with some text.

about: Opens apps, the camera and settings, uses the clipboard and shows notifications.
privacy: Clipboard text is shared only when you ask.

name: Weather
desc: Weather now and for the next few days.

tools.label: Weather
tools.hint: Tell the weather now and the forecast (free, no sign-in).

about: Tells you the weather now and for the next few days, for where you are or any city.
needs: Location access, only for where you are.
privacy: A city name or your location goes to a free weather service.

name: Web search
desc: Search the web.

tools.label: Search the web
tools.hint: Look up the latest information on the web.

about: Searches the web and answers from the results.
privacy: Your search words go to Ultron's server, which asks search engines. If it is down, your phone asks DuckDuckGo itself.

name: Web pages
desc: Read any web page or link.

tools.label: Read a web page
tools.hint: Read the main text of a web page from its address.

about: Reads a web page and gives you the main text.
privacy: The link you ask about goes to Ultron's server. Nothing is stored.

name: YouTube Search
desc: Search YouTube videos and playlists.

tools.label: Search YouTube
tools.hint: Search YouTube videos.

tools.label: Video details
tools.hint: Get the details of a YouTube video.

tools.label: Video transcript
tools.hint: Read the captions of a YouTube video.

tools.label: Channel or playlist videos
tools.hint: List the videos of a channel or playlist.

about: Searches videos and shows details, captions and playlists. YouTube sometimes blocks this.
privacy: Your search goes to Ultron's server, which asks YouTube.

name: YouTube Downloads
desc: Save YouTube videos or audio to your phone.

tools.label: Download options
tools.hint: List the formats and qualities a video can be downloaded in.

tools.label: Download YouTube video
tools.hint: Save a YouTube video or its audio to Downloads/Ultron.

about: Lets you pick a quality, then saves the video or audio to Downloads/Ultron.
privacy: Files stay on your phone. Download only what you may keep.

name: Calendar
desc: Check your schedule and add events.

tools.label: Read calendar
tools.hint: Tell the upcoming calendar events.

tools.label: Calendar conflicts
tools.hint: Check if a time slot is free.

tools.label: Add calendar event
tools.hint: Add an event to the calendar by itself.

tools.label: Cancel calendar event
tools.hint: Delete an event from the calendar by itself.

about: Checks your schedule, finds free time and adds or cancels events.
privacy: Event names and times are shared when you ask. Changes happen in your real calendar.

name: Contacts
desc: Find contacts, birthdays and save new contacts.

tools.label: Search contacts
tools.hint: Find a contact's number by name.

tools.label: Contact birthday
tools.hint: Tell a contact's birthday.

tools.label: Add a contact
tools.hint: Open a new-contact form (you press save).

about: Finds a contact's number and birthday, and opens a form to save a new contact.
privacy: Shared only when you ask.

name: Calls
desc: Call a contact by name.

tools.label: Call someone
tools.hint: Call a contact by name, or a number.

about: Calls the contact you name straight away, even when it is spelled differently on your phone. If two contacts fit, it asks which.
privacy: The call is placed on your phone and the name is matched on your phone. Nothing is sent except what you say to Gemini.

name: Location
desc: Know where you are and get directions.

tools.label: Current location
tools.hint: Tell where the phone is right now.

tools.label: Directions
tools.hint: Start navigation to a place.

about: Tells you where you are and starts directions in your maps app.
privacy: Your location is shared when you ask where you are.

name: Files
desc: Browse folders, find any file and open it.

tools.label: Search files
tools.hint: Find images, videos, audio and documents by name.

tools.label: Open a file
tools.hint: Show a file in the phone's default app.

tools.label: Browse a folder
tools.hint: Look inside a folder on the phone.

tools.label: Share a file
tools.hint: Send a found photo, video or document into an app such as WhatsApp.

about: Looks inside any folder on the phone, finds photos, videos, music, documents and any other file by name, and opens them in your own apps.
needs: All files access. A settings screen opens when you add it.
privacy: Names and folders are read on your phone. File contents are not sent anywhere unless you ask Ultron to read a file aloud.

name: Pictures
desc: Show pictures you saved in Ultron, or photos from your phone.

tools.label: Show a picture
tools.hint: Show a picture on the screen.

about: Shows a picture on the screen when you ask, from the pictures you added on the Images page or from a photo found with Files.
needs: Nothing. Add pictures on the Images page.
privacy: Pictures stay on your phone. They are not sent anywhere.

name: App usage
desc: See which apps you use most.

tools.label: Most used apps
tools.hint: Tell which apps are used most (sends app names to Gemini).

tools.label: App usage time
tools.hint: Tell how long one app was used (sends it to Gemini).

about: Shows which apps you use most and for how long.
privacy: App names and times are shared when you ask.

name: Notifications
desc: Read and reply to notifications.

tools.label: Read notifications
tools.hint: Read the phone's current notifications (sends their text to Gemini).

tools.label: Reply to a notification
tools.hint: Reply to a chat notification, for example WhatsApp (sends text).

tools.label: Dismiss notifications
tools.hint: Clear notifications from one app or all of them.

tools.label: What is playing
tools.hint: Tell which song or video is playing and in which app.

about: Reads your notifications so the assistant can tell you what you missed.
privacy: Notifications can be private. They are shared whenever you ask.

name: Phone navigation
desc: Go back, go home, scroll and take screenshots.

tools.label: Back button
tools.hint: Press the Back button.

tools.label: Recent apps
tools.hint: Open the recent apps screen.

tools.label: Previous app
tools.hint: Switch back to the app used before this one.

tools.label: Notification shade
tools.hint: Pull down the notification panel.

tools.label: Quick settings
tools.hint: Open the quick settings panel (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth tiles).

tools.label: Scroll
tools.hint: Scroll or swipe the screen up, down, left or right.

tools.label: Lock screen
tools.hint: Lock the phone.

tools.label: Screenshot
tools.hint: Take a screenshot (saved in the gallery).

tools.label: Go to home screen
tools.hint: Leave the current app and show the home screen.

tools.label: Power menu
tools.hint: Open the power off and restart menu.

tools.label: Split screen
tools.hint: Turn split screen on or off.

about: Goes back and home, opens recents, scrolls, locks the screen and takes screenshots.
needs: Accessibility access. A settings screen opens when you add it.
privacy: It does not read the screen.

name: Screen control
desc: Read the screen, tap and type.

tools.label: Read the screen
tools.hint: See the text and buttons on screen (sends them to Gemini).

tools.label: Look at the screen
tools.hint: See the screen as a picture when an app gives no readable text (sends a screenshot to Gemini).

tools.label: Current app
tools.hint: Tell which app is on screen.

tools.label: Click by text
tools.hint: Tap a button or link by its label.

tools.label: Click by number
tools.hint: Tap an item by its number from the last screen reading.

tools.label: Tap a position
tools.hint: Tap at exact screen coordinates.

tools.label: Type text
tools.hint: Type into the text field on screen.

tools.label: Press Enter
tools.hint: Submit the text field (Search/Go/Send).

tools.label: Wait for text
tools.hint: Wait until some text appears on screen.

tools.label: Swipe or drag
tools.hint: Swipe or drag between two points on the screen.

tools.label: Long press
tools.hint: Press and hold at screen coordinates.

about: Reads the screen and taps and types for you, so the assistant can use other apps.
needs: Accessibility access. A settings screen opens when you add it.
privacy: Screen text is shared with Gemini and can be private. Use with care.
